responsibility: Defines the multilib-capable x86-64 GNU-userspace ELF target configuration. It is responsible for selecting 32-bit, 64-bit, and x32 assembler and linker emulations, choosing the matching dynamic linker, setting multilib defaults, glibc thread offsets for SSP and split stack across ABI modes, and the wchar_t type policy that differs between LP64 and x32.
